articles.title: Congo’s fastest-growing Ebola outbreak reaches a sixth province - AP News
articles.description: Congo's Ebola outbreak has spread to a sixth province after a death in Bas-Uele, according to Africa's CDC. The outbreak, driven by the rare Bundibugyo virus, has killed over 2,100 people out of more than 4,500 cases. The World Health Organization says it's o…
